items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Kia Nurse averaged 5.5 points, 1.2 rebounds, and 1.0 assists in 43 games for the Toronto Tempo.

items.question: What team does Kia Nurse play for?
items.answer: Kia Nurse plays guard for the Toronto Tempo. She signed with Toronto on April 14, 2026, before the franchise's first WNBA season, and played 43 games for the Tempo that year.

items.question: Did Kia Nurse play at UConn?
items.answer: Yes. Kia Nurse was a four-year starter at UConn and won NCAA championships in 2015 and 2016. The Huskies reached the Final Four in all four of her seasons.

items.question: Who are Kia Nurse's parents?
items.answer: Kia Nurse's father, Richard, played in the CFL for the Hamilton Tiger-Cats, and her mother played basketball at McMaster University. Her sister Tamika played college basketball at Oregon and Bowling Green, and her brother Darnell was an NHL defenseman with the Edmonton Oilers when she was drafted in 2018.

items.question: Has Kia Nurse played in the Olympics?
items.answer: Yes. Kia Nurse has played for Canada at three Olympics, in 2016, 2020 and 2024. She also played in the 2014, 2018 and 2022 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cups.

items.question: When was Kia Nurse drafted?
items.answer: The New York Liberty selected Kia Nurse 10th overall in the 2018 WNBA Draft. As a rookie she scored 34 points at Indiana on June 2, 2018, a Liberty rookie record.

items.question: What WNBA teams has Kia Nurse played for?
items.answer: Kia Nurse has played for the New York Liberty, Phoenix Mercury, Seattle Storm, Los Angeles Sparks, Chicago Sky and Toronto Tempo.
